## GFP by spot

Now that I have aligned the images, I need to extract the average GFP signal for
each spot.

This means to extract the average intensity level of GFP by shape (spot).

Let's read the data.

```{python}
import spatialdata as sd
sdata = sd.read_zarr("c26t16_aligned.zarr")
transformed_sdata = sdata.transform_to_coordinate_system("aligned")
transformed_sdata

sd.aggregate(values=transformed_sdata["C26T16_GFP"], by = transformed_sdata["C26T16"], agg_func="mean", target_coordinate_system="aligned")
```


```{python}
import squidpy as sq

img = sq.im.ImageContainer(img="c26t16_aligned.zarr/images/C26T16_GFP/")
```
